name: LiveAgent
description: Support and Helpdesk: help desk software by Quality Unit with ticketing, live chat, call center and knowledge base.
access_notes: 30-day self-serve free trial, no credit card required; official pricing FAQ states 'API and integrations are included in each subscription without any additional costs'. Admins generate API v3 keys with per-key permissions under Configuration > System > API. The built-in MCP server uses per-agent Bearer tokens or OAuth 2.1 (Authorization Code + PKCE).
mcp_notes: Official built-in LiveAgent MCP server (shipped in v5.63, May 2026) at https://<account>/api/mcp, streamable HTTP, Bearer token or OAuth 2.1 auth, actions run under the agent's identity/permissions; admin-configurable tool subsets for AI agent connections. No Composio LiveAgent toolkit found (composio.dev/toolkits/liveagent returns 404).
uncertainty_notes: Webhook support not confirmed from a dedicated official docs page: LiveAgent appears to deliver event callbacks via automation rules with HTTP-request actions rather than a formal webhooks API, so supports_webhooks is left null. API v1 is deprecated but still functional alongside the current API v3.

evidence.note: Admins self-serve API keys at Configuration > System > API; API v3 keys support per-key permissions; key sent in 'apikey' request header.
Official REST API section covering API v1 (legacy) and API v3 (current) with documentation and examples.
Official built-in MCP server at https://<account>/api/mcp, streamable HTTP, Bearer token or OAuth 2.1 (Authorization Code + PKCE), acting under the agent's identity.
Vendor blog: 'version 5.63 also comes with the integration of LiveAgent MCP' connecting Claude Desktop, Cursor, claude.ai, FlowHunt etc.
30-day free trial, no credit card; three per-agent subscription tiers; 'API and integrations are included in each subscription'.
